resolution: The new three-way Model Focus diagnosis proved the GUI and Seat agree: primitive:cube:46 resolves to cart/editor/data/models/props/Model_46, but its actual RJMD v4 header contains no semantic rows/table, so mount and resident are correctly anonymous. The prior save response merely echoed live percept; it did not verify the written blob, and the file was written before the rebuilt native writer timestamp. Expanded the panel/semantic-status to compare disk RJMD, ModelView mount, and native resident state with MOUNT DROP vs LOAD MISMATCH distinctions. Added a deep save postcondition: after native write, reparse and compare named-face count plus semantic dictionary; on mismatch restore the exact prior blob and fail the save. Anonymous hydration can no longer overwrite a named durable document. ReleaseFast editor build and 31 focused V8 tests pass. Existing Model_46 names were never present in the saved blob; recovery requires re-authoring or an explicit transcript-based restoration.
